title: DocMap workspace JSON (backup)
description: The file written by 'Salva backup' (docmap_workspace_AAAAMMGG_HHMM.json) and by Esporta e Salva › Sessione completa JSON (docmap_workspace.json): workspaceJSON(true) in assets/js/04-ui.js, plus the key sync_journal added by 06i-journal.js when the local journal is not empty. Sessions stored in SQLite (sessions.workspace_json) use the same format without activity_log and sync_journal. No photos: they live only in the .sqlite. Contract: docs/MODELLO-DATI.md §8.

version.description: APP_VERSION of the writer (26.11.1 for v11.1).

print.description: Print preferences S.print (presetId, geometry, contentMode, fields, split, info, edge, pages, ...): docs/MODELLO-DATI.md §4. Device preference, not archive data.

contentMode.description: info · split · pair · a · b · u · qr · loc

usedSlots.description: {presetId: [0-based slot indices already used on the partial sheet]}

locations.description: v11 (absent in older files = no change to the tree).

activity_log.description: v9, backups only: merged by id on restore, never replaced.

sync_journal.description: v11, backups only, present when the local journal is not empty: merged by id on 'ripristina tutto' + Sostituisci.

settings.description: S.settings (docs/MODELLO-DATI.md §4). Archive-wide values (studioName, destTemplate, colours, location levels) travel in sync packages as settingsSubset; the others are preferences of this device.

deviceId.description: v10 sync: 'dev-' + uuid of this installation (localStorage docmap_v26_device wins over a restored copy).
